title: Scaling Reasoning in Language Models with Verifier-Guided Search
content_text: We introduce a verifier-guided search procedure that improves multi-step reasoning in large language models by reranking candidate chains of thought against a learned correctness signal, yielding consistent gains on math and code benchmarks.
summary_short: Verifier-guided search boosts LLM multi-step reasoning on math and code tasks.

title: huggingface/transformers v5.2.0 released
content_text: Release v5.2.0 adds native support for several new open-weight models, faster attention kernels, and improved quantization utilities for inference on consumer GPUs.
summary_short: Transformers v5.2.0 adds new model support, faster kernels, and better quantization.

title: Show HN: A local-first agent that builds your morning brief
content_text: A developer shares a local-first pipeline that aggregates arXiv, GitHub, Hacker News, and RSS into a single summarized morning digest delivered over email or chat webhooks.
summary_short: A local-first tool aggregates multiple sources into a daily summarized digest.

title: New developer tools for building reliable agents
content_text: An update introduces evaluation harnesses, tracing, and structured output guarantees aimed at making production agent deployments more reliable and observable.
summary_short: New tooling targets reliability and observability for production agents.

title: The state of small language models in 2026
content_text: An overview of how compact, efficient language models are increasingly deployed on-device, trading raw capability for latency, privacy, and cost advantages.
summary_short: Small, efficient LMs gain traction for on-device, low-latency, private use cases.
